NTA CSIR UGC NET December Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Short Details : National Testing Agency (NTA-CSIR UGC NET) has released the notification for the CSIR UGC NET December 2026 Examination on the official website of the NTA recently. The online application process for NTA CSIR UGC NET December Online Form 2026 has started on 07 October 2026, and candidates can apply till 05 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NTA CSIR UGC NET December Online Form 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 October 2026
  • Last Date : 05 November 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 November 2026
  • Last Date Late Fee Payment : 09 November 2026
  • Correction Date : 10-12 November 2026
  • Exam Date : 19, 22, 27 December 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 1150/-
  • EWS, OBC NCL : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 325/-
  • Late Fees : Rs. 500/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
